### 🎯 Objective
Import Lab 8 starter skeleton files and test suite from `public_materials/lab08/starter/`, wire prompt injection guard into service dispatch, set up CI red-team workflow, coordinate team PRs, and tag release `v0.8-tested`.

### 📋 Detailed Tasks
- [ ] Import starter skeleton files from `public_materials/lab08/starter/`:
  - Copy `src/assistant_core/guard.py` (with starter patterns and `looks_like_injection`).
  - Copy `redteam/` directory (`redteam/cases.jsonl`, `redteam/run_redteam.py`).
  - Copy test suites: `tests/test_security.py` and `tests/test_my_regressions.py`.
  - Copy worksheets to `docs/lab8/`: `failure_catalogue.md`, `redteam_exchange.md`, `bug_report_template.md`.
- [ ] Integrate prompt injection guard in `src/assistant_core/service.py`:
  - Call `looks_like_injection(msg.text)` before routing to return `INJECTION_REPLY` with `path="abstain"`.
- [ ] Update GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  - Add `redteam-testing` job running `python redteam/run_redteam.py`.
  - Add `security-testing` job running `pytest -v tests/test_security.py tests/test_my_regressions.py`.
- [ ] Team coordination & release:
  - Track team milestone progress across PRs #1 through #6.
  - Review and approve team PRs sequentially into `main`.
  - Tag milestone release `v0.8-tested` upon full integration.

title: [Lab 8 - Team] Red-Team Exchange Attack Suite Authoring (Part F.2) - doomsdaycome
body:
**Week**: Lab 08 (Testing, Debugging & Red Teaming)
**Type**: Team Integration Task
**Member**: @doomsdaycome
**Reviewer**: @tl7243
**Branch**: `feat/lab8-redteam-cases`

### 🎯 Objective
Author a comprehensive test suite of 8–10 attack cases in `redteam/cases_for_partner.jsonl` following the Lab 8 JSONL format, covering all 6 critical categories (prompt-injection, privacy, out-of-scope, malformed-input, fee-manipulation, unavailable-service) plus normal control cases.

### 📋 Detailed Tasks
- [ ] Create `redteam/cases_for_partner.jsonl` with 8–10 attack test cases.
- [ ] Ensure coverage across all required categories:
  - Prompt injection (e.g., pretend to be dean, bypass rules)
  - Privacy (e.g., requesting classmate address, phone, or GPA)
  - Out-of-scope (e.g., non-university queries)
  - Malformed input (e.g., empty or oversized string)
  - Fee manipulation (e.g., negative credits or zero tuition bypass)
  - Unavailable service (e.g., fallback when LLM is down)
- [ ] Include 1–2 normal control cases (`expect_contains`) to ensure the assistant does not over-refuse legitimate student queries.

### 🧪 Testing & Verification
```powershell
python -c "import json, pathlib; cases = [json.loads(x) for x in pathlib.Path('redteam/cases_for_partner.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]; print(f'Valid cases: {len(cases)}')"
```
